correctness.rationale: Independently expanded composed explicit RK maps through h^3 on quadratic scalar vector fields, checking h²(1+u+v)Df f and pair defect h³[-A/3+((1-u)^2-1/3)H]. Uniform centered-stage variance is 4/45. Discrete Gronwall gives the pair-endpoint O(h²) bound; linearized variation of constants leaves uniform O(h³) propagated remainder, and independent-pair bounded triangular-array CLT gives covariance 2/45 integral. Linear f(x)=x logarithmic multiplier has leading random term h²(U+V-1) and asymptotic variance (T/2)e^(2T)y0² Var(U+V); Var=0 forces V=1-U. Independently quadrature-checked sine benchmark bias -0.01059210684879069 and variance 0.01687697607142204.
residual_risks: Gaussian covariance may degenerate; only smooth autonomous globally Lipschitz vector fields at pair endpoints, independent pairs, fixed finite T and uniform marginals.
